$doNotEditByHand: Re-run the extractor instead. A diff here after a version bump IS the drift report.
$defaultIsNotDelegatedSet: solid's generateHydrationScript defaults to 2 events (click, input); the dom-expressions DelegatedEvents set has 22. These are different mechanisms: the bootstrap captures pre-hydration events, delegation dispatches post-hydration.

hyShape.events: array of [element, event] captured before hydration
hyShape.completed: WeakSet of already-hydrated elements (excluded from capture)
hyShape.r: resource registry -- inert {} in the non-streaming build, key must exist
hyShape.fe: flush-events hook -- no-op stub, must exist as a callable
hyShape.$noDoneField: the initial shape has NO 'done' field; the client assigns it later

ownerLookup: walks up from composedPath()[0] (falling back to event.target) to the nearest ancestor with a data-hk attribute, hopping shadow roots via .host
